contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy barbarous radiate coin of the Roman period of an uncertain emperor (c. AD250-300 AD ). Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: [--------]AVG. Reverse description: unclear. The coin is in a very poor condition with very little information available to be able to make a definitive identification. Length: 18.27 mm. Height: 16.35 mm. Thickness: 1.82 mm. Weight: 1.8 g
